# The Secret Florist – Pondicherry

> Fresh, handcrafted bouquets with same-day delivery in Pondicherry (Puducherry), India.

## About
The Secret Florist is a local flower shop in Pondicherry offering online ordering of fresh bouquets for birthdays, anniversaries, love, surprises, and special occasions. All arrangements are handcrafted with premium seasonal flowers.

## Services
- Online bouquet ordering
- Same-day flower delivery in Pondicherry
- Birthday bouquets
- Anniversary flowers
- Rose bouquets
- Customized floral gifts
- Money bouquets, perfume bouquets, chocolate bouquets, and more
